packageRules.description: New Kotlin versions need a matching SKIE release, so they must land in a single PR. KSP is versioned independently of Kotlin since 2.3.0 and updates on its own.

sqlite-jdbc must match the version SQLDelight's sqlite-driver brings in and the macOS sandbox native library in desktopApp/resources-sandbox. Update it by hand together with SQLDelight (see the comment in gradle/libs.versions.toml).

Screenshot renderer is pinned deliberately: playwright-core determines the rendering engine, so an unattended bump can silently change text rasterisation and shift the shipped store screenshots. Update by hand, then run tools/screenshots/verify.mjs.
